core_categories: Foot and Heel Care; Stretching and Flexibility Devices; Massage and Trigger Point Therapy Tools; Joint Bracing and Support; Skin and Anti-Chafing Protection
specialty_focus: Medi-Dyne Healthcare Products is a manufacturer and global distributor of drug-free, non-invasive medical devices and personal care products for pain prevention, injury treatment, and physical recovery. It specializes in products for the lower kinetic chain, serving athletes, patients, and clinical professionals in over 70 countries. The company does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices but offers mechanical aids like heel cups, calf stretchers, and joint straps.
key_brands: Tuli's, ProStretch, Cho-Pat, 2Toms, CoreStretch, RangeRoller, Skin-on-Skin, StretchRite, others
